title: Orto recall and a Strumentario write in one turn
body:
Orto and Strumentario never call each other. The agent is the seam: it recalls from the memory bank, then writes through the page tools. There is no shared code or store.

One turn, in order:
1. Recall. Ask the Hindsight bank "strumentario" (recall, or reflect for the why) for the decision or standard that bears on the edit. Treat what comes back as a record of the past and check it against the repo before relying on it.
2. Read. query the page being changed and keep its revision.
3. Draft, then validate. The recalled standard shapes the draft; validate only checks the schema (non-empty title, kebab-case slug, non-empty body), not the facts.
4. Write. mutate dry run, then dryRun false with expectedRevision and an idempotencyKey.
5. Confirm. query the page again; the journal entry is the proof of the write.

What goes where: durable project knowledge stays in the repo docs and ADRs that Orto seeds into the bank. Pages in this store are the operating notes you maintain; do not retain page bodies into the bank by hand, and never put secrets in either.

Current limit: both servers are not yet registered side by side for the Cursor session (stdio registration is pending, #42), so step 4 runs through the CLI today.
